{"diagnosis":"A same-day re-delivery in batch 13 (ingest 02:00 and again 22:00) sent a second copy of 20 txn_ids with a different amount. The copies are identical except for amount and ingest_ts, so these look like restatements. The later ingest should win. silver_transactions has no dedup, so 18 of these keys show up twice among POSTED rows and double-count in the gold tables.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.72,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts,
       CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM raw_transactions
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1
) r
WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
